entities.name: Amelogenin Y isoform
observations: 203-aa query exactly matches reviewed Pan troglodytes UniProt Q861X8; human AMELY Q99218 is 86.7% identical across 100% query coverage.
Reference annotations describe a secreted extracellular-matrix protein involved in tooth-enamel crystallite organization and mineralization.
Reference localizations: secreted, extracellular space, extracellular matrix.
Biological process annotation: enamel mineralization (GO:0070166); molecular function: structural constituent of tooth enamel (GO:0030345).

entities.name: Enamel mineralization
observations: Amelogenin Y is annotated as participating in enamel mineralization (GO:0070166), coordinating developing enamel structure/mineral crystallite formation.

entities.name: Extracellular matrix
observations: Amelogenin Y reference annotations place it in the extracellular matrix and extracellular space after secretion.
